title: Grateful Dead Live at Music Hall on 1971-12-02
source: Source Info: FM Broadcast; Unknown Analog Master > 2 cassette generations > PCM; Transfer Info: PCM (Sony SL-10)> Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 (wav 16-bit/44.1k)> Adobe Audition 3.0 > TLH flac16

ai_review.summary: Great‑sounding recording of a smoking show, highlighted by an epic Smokestack Lightning performance.
ai_review.review: The reviewer raves that the tape sounds great and describes the concert as a total smokeshow, with Smokestack Lightning standing out so much it “made my head fall off.” No technical flaws are mentioned, and the energy is portrayed as high‑octane throughout the set.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one brief review; it is enthusiastic about both the music and sound quality, suggesting a strong show with good recording, but limited data keeps confidence low.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer says “sounds great,” indicating clear, listenable audio with no noted issues.
